sections.title: Intermediate Trigonometry Concepts
sections.content: At level 2, we study angles beyond 30°, 45°, 60° and learn sum and difference formulas for sin, cos, and tan, along with their applications.

sections.title: Sum and Difference Formulas
sections.content:
sin(A ± B) = sinA cosB ± cosA sinB
cos(A ± B) = cosA cosB ∓ sinA sinB
tan(A ± B) = (tanA ± tanB) / (1 ∓ tanA tanB)

sections.title: Double Angle and Half Angle Formulas
sections.content:
2 sinA cosA = sin2A
cos²A - sin²A = cos2A
1 - 2 sin²A = cos2A

sections.title: Using Sides and Ratios
sections.content: In right-angled triangles, we can find unknown sides using sin, cos, and tan ratios of known angles.

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content:
1. Forgetting ± signs in sum/difference formulas
2. Taking wrong angles in triangles
3. Making mistakes in double angle formulas

sections.title: Quick Summary
sections.content: Remember sum, difference, double angle, and half-angle formulas. Solve problems step by step and check calculations carefully.

tricks.title: Remember Sum/Difference Formulas
tricks.explanation: sin(A ± B) = sinA cosB ± cosA sinB, cos(A ± B) = cosA cosB ∓ sinA sinB

tricks.title: Use Double Angle Formulas
tricks.explanation: 2 sinA cosA = sin2A, cos²A - sin²A = cos2A to quickly calculate values

tricks.title: Quick Tan Sum/Difference
tricks.explanation: tan(A + B) = (tanA + tanB) / (1 - tanA tanB), tan(A - B) = (tanA - tanB)/(1 + tanA tanB)

tricks.title: Memorize Standard Angles
tricks.explanation: Remember sin, cos, tan values for 30°, 45°, 60° to speed up calculations

tricks.title: Fast Trigonometric Evaluation
tricks.explanation: Use fractions or √ values for standard angles to calculate quickly
